title: EvidenceClaim
description: One evidence atom. The statement is the sentence a surface is licensed to assert, verbatim or lightly re-cased. Retractions live in retractions.json, not here: a claim record is never a tombstone.

kind.description: metric = carries a number covered by the C8 numeric gate. fact = a checkable non-numeric assertion. narrative = a framing sentence built only from other claims (derivedFrom non-empty). caveat = an honesty rider emitted WITH the claims that list it.

subject.description: What this claim is ABOUT. Exactly one subject, so 'tell me about the Fischer work' is a filter, not a search.

value.description: REQUIRED when kind = metric. The single source of every digit that reaches a surface.

numbers.description: Every numeric token in display, as written, including sign and decimals. If a quantity can be rendered two ways (0.487 and 48.7%), list BOTH. This array feeds the C8 allowlist.

baseline.description: What the value is measured against, in words. Required in practice when display carries a delta.

status.description: verified = happened, sourced, current. in-progress = underway and NOT shipped; copy stays present-progressive. historical = true and sourced but from a superseded phase; assertable, de-weighted. disputed = two sources of Duy's own disagree; NOT assertable, agent reports the disagreement.

evidenceStrength.description: WHAT KIND of experience this is. Load-bearing for honesty: it is what lets a fit brief say 'coursework, not production' instead of letting a course sit silently next to a job.

verificationPath.description: THE ONE THING A SKEPTIC OPENS. Repo-relative path (optionally with :Lnn), a git-object locator, an absolute local archive path, or an absolute URL.

verifiedOn.description: When the value was last checked against the primary source. MANDATORY on claims about live, moving work (Addendum A.5) — enforced by C13.

derivedFrom.description: REQUIRED and non-empty for kind=narrative. A narrative sentence may combine claims; it may not add a fact.

asserted.description: May a surface state this as fact? MUST be false for status=disputed.
